engine.description: Black Corporation Ise-Nin eight-voice analog synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI CC chart, its Upper and Lower layers each with its own.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/blackcorp/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/blackcorp/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC chart, sent as a control change. Its name is the chart's less the kind of control (SLIDER, POT, KNOB, BUTTON, SWITCH), which its description keeps. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The chart prints no values: every controller is 0 - 127, the buttons included. The Upper and Lower layers answer on the one channel, each control of a layer on a controller of its own, as the chart's LAYER column says.

Left out, the wheel, the pedal, bank select and CC 74, the MPE controllers' slide (whose destination the CC74 REPLACE setting chooses): CC 0 BANK SELECT, CC 1 MODULATION WHEEL, CC 64 SUSTAIN PEDAL, CC 74 CC74 REPLACE (MPE).

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
